title: Accounting Analyst
description:
Select how often (in days) to receive an alert:

We are looking for an Accounting Analyst who is passionate about being involved in a growing business unit!

About the Role

This is a role where you will be a key player in the end-to-end preparation of the financial close of non-technical entities, which is performed based on the locally generally accepted accounting principles (BRGAAP). Additionally, you will be required to search for ways of improving the accounting related processes that are current in place.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support on the preparation of financial close schedule.
  • Coordinate with all parties involved in the financial close to make sure it is finalized in a reasonable timeframe.
  • Ensure that all accounting entries are BRGAAP compliant.
  • Perform journal entries on a monthly and quarterly basis.
  • Reconciliation of balance sheet and income statement financial accounts.
  • Provide the management with ad-hoc reports.

About the Team

Finance Brazil is responsible for statutory and regulatory reports for all Swiss Re entities in Brazil, covering local and admitted reinsurers, an insurance company, one service company and one holding company. With more than 30 employees located in São Paulo, the team also provides services for the business team by providing strategics inputs for the development of the company in the country.

About You

You are a great communicator with superior organization, and you complement your excellent analytical skills with a holistic financial approach.

Must Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting.
  • At least three years of work experience in financial close activities.
  • Strong analytical skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in the insurance industry.
  • CPA certification.
  • Intermediate ability to communicate clearly, read and write in English.

About Swiss Re

Swiss Re is one of the world’s leading providers of reinsurance, insurance and other forms of insurance-based risk transfer, working to make the world more resilient. We anticipate and manage a wide variety of risks, from natural catastrophes and climate change to cybercrime. We cover both Property & Casualty and Life & Health. Combining experience with creative thinking and cutting-edge expertise, we create new opportunities and solutions for our clients. This is possible thanks to the collaboration of more than 14,000 employees across the world.

Our success depends on our ability to build an inclusive culture encouraging fresh perspectives and innovative thinking. We embrace a workplace where everyone has equal opportunities to thrive and develop professionally regardless of their age, gender, race, ethnicity, gender identity and/or expression, sexual orientation, physical or mental ability, skillset, thought or other characteristics. In our inclusive and flexible environment everyone can bring their authentic selves to work and their passion for sustainability.

If you are an experienced professional returning to the workforce after a career break, we encourage you to apply for open positions that match your skills and experience.

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for people with disabilities in all our positions.

Job description

Se você tem perfil comercial, é comunicativo, gosta de gente e quer se desenvolver em um ambiente dinâmico, as nossas agências e/ou sede são o lugar ideal para acelerar sua carreira!

No Programa de Estágio Acelera Planalto Central , você vai vivenciar o dia a dia do relacionamento com o cooperado, aprender na prática e desenvolver habilidades essenciais para o mundo do trabalho — tudo isso com propósito e espaço para crescer.

Aqui, você vai viver na prática o nosso propósito: o seu talento para um mundo melhor! Acreditamos que a transformação começa pelas pessoas — e é por isso que colocamos você no centro de tudo.

Nosso programa é feito para quem quer evoluir constantemente, se desenvolver em um ambiente humano e acolhedor, aprendizado real e o apoio de quem acredita no seu potencial. O Programa de Estágio Acelera Planalto Central tem duração de 1 ano, com possibilidade de prorrogação por até 2 anos , e foi pensado para desenvolver seu potencial de forma completa — combinando teoria, prática e muita vivência no dia a dia das nossas agências.

Durante o programa, você vai:

  1. Atuar diretamente nas agências da nossa Cooperativa, acompanhando o atendimento aos cooperados e conhecendo de perto a rotina comercial;
  2. Aprender sobre nossos produtos, serviços e processos, desenvolvendo habilidades técnicas e comportamentais essenciais para o mercado financeiro;
  3. Receber uma trilha estruturada de desenvolvimento, com conteúdos sobre cooperativismo, atendimento, negócios e muito mais;
  4. Ter o acompanhamento de tutores e líderes engajados em apoiar seu crescimento profissional e pessoal;
  5. Participar de imersões em diferentes áreas da Cooperativa, ampliando sua visão sobre o negócio e as possibilidades de carreira;
  6. Ser protagonista da sua trajetória, com autonomia e espaço para inovar, contribuir e crescer!

E além de tudo... Você poderá ser efetivado e seguir voando ainda mais alto com a gente! Aqui, reconhecemos talentos de verdade!

Requirements and skills

Para fazer parte dessa jornada com a gente, você precisa:

  1. Estar matriculado e frequentando regularmente um curso de graduação nas áreas: Administração, Economia, Ciências Contábeis, Gestão comercial ou áreas correlatas;
  2. Ter disponibilidade para estagiar 06h por dia - 09h00 às 16h00 com 1h de almoço;
  3. Ter previsão de conclusão do curso a partir de dezembro de 2026;
  4. Morar na região ou ter facilidade de deslocamento até a agência onde irá atuar;
  5. Ser comunicativo, curioso e com vontade de aprender e se desenvolver constantemente;

Additional information

Porque aqui a gente cuida de quem faz parte do nosso time — e não é só com palavras! Os benefícios que você vai ter:

  2. Plano de Saúde - Bradesco Top Nacional 100% pago por nós;

description:

We combine the disruptive power of Artificial Intelligence with human expertise to support large companies in navigating changes in technology and business. Impact is what we deliver.

We are looking for a Senior Android Developer to work with us serving one of the major American investment clients.

This position requires living in Campinas to work on-site every day, this position is 100% "presencial" .

So if you like working close to your peers, this is the perfect job for you! Furthermore, you will have the opportunity to use your English every day, having contact with people from different countries.

  5. Conduct thorough testing and debugging of code to ensure high-quality deliverables.
  6. Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to fellow team members.

  1. Previous experience as an Android Developer using Java and Kotlin;
  2. Solid experience with Kotlin language and coding conventions.
  3. Knowledge of dependency injection technique with Dagger or Hilt;
  4. Knowledge of software architectural patterns like REST, MVVM, MVC, and Clean;
  5. Experience in unit testing with JUnit and automated UI testing, with Espresso.
  6. Familiarity with componentization of interface elements and basic knowledge of Material Design.
  7. Experience with code versioning using Git and familiarity with Git Flow working with multiple teams.
  8. Knowledge/Experience working in a mature CI/CD environment with GitHub Actions;
  9. Conversational English Level.

Nice to have:

  1. Experience migrating from Java to Kotlin in Android apps.
  2. Experience migrating from single-module to multi-module architecture.
  3. Experience supporting QA Engineers with E2E Automation with Appium.
  4. Feature toggles and trunk-based development experience.
  5. Some experience with Node.js or reading and understanding Node applications.
  6. Desired experience with Adobe tools such as Adobe Target, Adobe Analytics, AEM, etc.

description:

2 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Software Support Engineer role at Canonical

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
We are hiring a Software Support Engineer to…
…work in a dynamic and exciting engineering role in Linux-based infrastructure and applications, covering all layers of the stack, including bare metal, virtualization (KVM), containerization (Docker/LXC/LXD), storage (Ceph and Linux filesystems), networking (OVS, OVN and Core networking), OpenStack, Kubernetes and the open source applications running on top of them. It will challenge you to show the breadth of your engineering skills, which will be needed to work on almost any aspect of Ubuntu and the open source applications large enterprise customers run.
This role is an opportunity for a technologist with a passion for Linux and open source to build a career with Canonical and drive success for our customers, community and the company. If you have an affinity for open source software, great communication skills, and a passion for troubleshooting and fixing issues in technology used by millions across the world, then you will enjoy working with some of the best people in the industry at Canonical.
This role deals with critical issues in the open source stack that require upstream bug fixes. Our engineers are able to work productively at any level of the stack including the kernel and in a wide range of languages, to understand and address the software issues at hand. Our group is critical to the success of our customers, partners and Ubuntu itself.
You will help with troubleshooting and driving issues to resolution with workarounds, guidance, and bug fixes to be released upstream and in Ubuntu.
Location: This is a remote role, we have teams in all time zones.
The role entails

  • Resolve complex customer problems related to Ubuntu, Kernel, Ceph, OpenStack, or Kubernetes and other open source software
  • Maintain a close working relationship with Canonical's Field, Support and product engineering teams
  • Participate in upstream communities
  • Develop bug fixes, backport patches, and work with upstream for inclusion
  • Review code produced by other engineers
  • Demonstrate good judgment in technical methods and techniques
  • Prioritize work and manage your time effectively against those priorities
  • Participate in team discussions to improve processes, tools, and documentation
  • Maintain clear, technical and concise communications
  • Work from home and travel internationally up to 10% of work time for team meetings, events and conferences
What we are looking for in you
  • An exceptional academic track record
  • Background in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • Experience with Linux and open source software
  • Experience with at least one of Python, Go, C or C++ on Linux
  • A drive to learn unfamiliar technology and deep-dive difficult issues
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
Nice-to-have skills
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have interest in, or willingness to learn about any of the following: Ubuntu Linux - kernel or userspace, Kubernetes, OpenStack, Ceph, QEMU/KVM, LXC/LXD,Postgresql, Mongo, Debian packaging, distributed systems
What we offer colleagues
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognize outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Sr. Tax Analyst, BR Tax Compliance team
description:
Are you ready to take on complex tax challenges at a global leader in technology, commerce, and innovation? We're hiring a Sr. Tax Analyst! If you're looking for a new opportunity, check out this open role on our Tax Compliance team in Brazil.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Bachelor’s degree preferred in Economics, Finance, Business, Accounting or related field, and preferred additional academic development in Taxation.
  2. +5 years of relevant tax experience in a corporate environment, public accounting firm or major law firm.
  3. Significant experience in Brazil (ICMS, ICMS ST, PIS, COFINS and ISS).
  4. Understanding of or practical experience related to digital and marketplace businesses.
  5. Strong communication skills with the ability to articulate complex tax laws in a business setting, both in Portuguese and English, including the ability to communicate effectively, participate in daily video conferences, write, and understand emails.

  1. Responsible for managing day-to-day Tax Compliance reporting for key Amazon group entities. Additionally, responsible for coordinating tax compliance activities, ensuring adherence to company deadlines and internal controls.
  2. Working closely with cross function teams and designing or improving tax compliant processes.
  3. Evaluating the tax effect and implications of business initiatives, contemplated transactions, and business proposals, from a tax compliance perspective. Also, active participation in company projects, resolving doubts and proposing tax paths and solutions.
  4. Work with other stakeholders, including Accounting, to prepare tax calculation records, reconcile tax returns, and ensure accuracy.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  1. Significant experience in Brazil (ICMS, ICMS ST, PIS, COFINS and ISS). Also, it is a plus to have an understanding of or practical experience related to digital, cloud, and marketplace businesses.

Registrar os produtos adquiridos pelos clientes, fazer as devidas cobranças e atendê-los da melhor forma possível.

description:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, a similar technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of work experience in a technical role (e.g., software engineering, solutions consultant, etc.) or equivalent technical experience.
  • Experience speaking at technology conferences, blogging/writing technical articles with an existing follower base, or contributing to a popular open source project.
  • Experience in the areas of Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence or GenAI, including ability to guide developers on the use of these technologies.
  • Ability to communicate in Portuguese and English fluently to support the local and global developer community.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Experience in coding/engineering beneficial to the technical domain.
  • Ability to take ownership of solutions and exert influence without authority.
  • Ability to work globally and collaboratively in a team environment, be diplomatic, and influence technical practitioners, stakeholders, and globally distributed teams.
  • Ability to share technical knowledge and information with others.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate in Spanish fluently to support the community in the LATAM region.

About the job

Passionate people are everywhere at Google. In Developer Relations, we get excited to collaborate and connect with the communities that love technology as much as we do. Part community manager and part developer advocate, Developer Relations Engineers collaborate with developers at conferences and online, and advocate for developers interests internally at Google. Not afraid to be hands-on, you write sample code and client libraries as well as participate in developer forums and support queues to troubleshoot and debug coding problems developers encounter. Internally, you work with product engineering teams to improve our products by conveying feedback from developers, reviewing API designs and testing new features. Chrome, Android, App Engine, HTML5 as well as our core Google Apps and Ads APIs are just some of the platforms you promote and support.
With your technical expertise, you drive strategy around fostering a community of developers who work with Google technologies. An ardent advocate for these developers, you represent their voice internally to our Product Managers and serve as their Google support in application development and technology implementation.

As a Cloud Developer Relations Engineer, you’ll join a team of Practitioners that empathize deeply with external technical communities, and advocate on their behalf to the Google Cloud Product and Engineering teams, ensuring that our products are built to meet the community's needs and that they provide the best possible user and developer experiences. You’ll work to raise awareness of Cloud technologies and methodologies within our technical communities through enablement and inspiration, and you’ll drive strategy around Google Developer Relations efforts for specific communities and products.

Responsibilities

  • Advocate for the community internally and influence Google Cloud product strategy by working with cross-functional teams. Support an inclusive work environment.
  • Synthesize feedback in order to drive continuous improvement to Google Cloud Platform products and to the overall experience of the platform by technical practitioners.
  • Participate in technical communities as a practitioner having, or developing, deep understanding of that community’s needs. Build and foster an external community ecosystem of influencers, meetups, experts that amplify messages and extend the reach.
  • Represent the needs of relevant technical communities throughout the entire product lifecycle, including input on design discussions, customer zero testing, launch, post-launch updates.
  • Work with Product and Engineering teams to define product strategies and to craft narratives around new products and features.

CyberArk (NASDAQ: CYBR) is the global leader in Identity Security. As a critical technical voice in the field, you'll work directly with customers and prospects to understand their business goals and design secure, scalable identity solutions that meet them. You’ll lead engaging product demonstrations, run workshops, guide evaluations, and partner with Sales Specialists to drive opportunities from discovery through technical close.

You’ll also play a proactive role in the field beyond deal cycles—supporting marketing efforts that generate new pipeline, contributing to technical content like demos and videos, and offering real-world feedback to Product teams to make our solutions better. Your ability to clearly explain technical capabilities, identify integration paths, and troubleshoot challenges will directly impact customer success.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys diving into details, creating clarity from complexity, and helping others do the same. You’ll collaborate with peers across sales, product management, and engineering while also producing documentation, guides, and reusable assets that empower others.

How You Operate:

  • You enjoy solving customer problems, not just implementing software.
  • You’re energized by explaining complex topics simply and clearly.
  • You proactively share your knowledge through documentation, training, or peer support.
  • You’re comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • You collaborate well across departments and are comfortable taking initiative.
  • You adapt quickly to new tools and aren’t afraid to ask questions or challenge assumptions.
  • You stay focused on delivering real customer value—not just checking boxes.
  • You love presenting to both technical and executive audiences at multiple levels of an organization.

What You Bring:

  • A passion for working with customers and a deep belief in problem solving as a team sport.
  • 3–5 years of experience in hands-on administration or selling an IAM, IGA solution.
  • 3–5 years of experience delivering, supporting, or selling identity governance and/or access management solutions, either as a practitioner or a solutions engineer.
  • Hands-on experience with identity lifecycle management, access certifications, and directory services.
  • Familiarity with authentication protocols: SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, WS-Fed.
  • Knowledge of legacy authentication protocols such as Basic Auth, NTLM, Kerberos, and RADIUS.
  • Strong understanding of MFA, secure authentication principles, and Zero Trust models.
  • Experience supporting authentication across Windows, macOS, and Linux environments.
  • Deployment and integration experience using Docker, Podman.
  • REST API proficiency and use of API testing tools like Postman or Bruno.
  • Exposure to and/or administering identity platforms/directories like CyberArk, Active Directory, LDAP, SailPoint, Saviynt, Okta, or Microsoft Entra ID.
  • Deep understanding of IAM Compliance, Governance, Lifecycle, and Workflows best practices.
  • Experience with Workday, ADP, BambooHR a definite plus.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a strong drive to teach, document, and enable others.
  • Respect for security principles and best practices.

Requirements:

  • Fluency in Portuguese.
  • Advanced proficiency in English.
  • Spanish a plus.
  • Willingness to travel up to 30%.
  • Certifications such as CCSP, Okta Certified Professional, AWS Certified Solutions Architect, or Microsoft Certification: Identity and Access Administrator Associate would be a bonus.

  • Administer and enhance Azure AD B2C, ensuring secure authentication and identity management
  • Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and disaster recovery strategies, ensuring data integrity and business continuity
  • Work closely with Engineering and Security teams, documenting best practices, infrastructure changes, and operational procedures
Company Benefits
  • Competitive salary and bonuses, including performance-based salary increases.
  • Generous paid-time-off policy
  • Flexible working hours
  • Work remotely
  • Continuing education, training, conferences
  • Company-sponsored coursework, exams, and certifications

title: Project Engineer
description:
The Project Engineer position is responsible for assisting and supporting Senior Project Managers and Project Directors in representing Roeslein & Associates in all matters involving the prospecting for and the proposing, negotiating, securing, and implementation of our projects and will serve as the customer's single point of interface throughout each of his/her projects.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Assist Business Development in developing estimates and schedule for proposals; presenting proposals to existing and potential customers; and developing and maintaining existing customer relationships; and assist Business Development in developing new customer relationships.
  • Assist Project Managers responsible for customer management and communication, including change orders, engineering details, invoicing, and project schedule updates.
  • Assist Project Managers responsible for project financials, including reviewing job cost details, reviewing actuals vs. estimated costs, invoicing, and monthly projections.

  • Prepare all proposal documents for all RFQs (proposal, estimate, schedule, clarifications & exceptions, etc). Estimates and proposals must meet client RFQ requirements for format and content.

  • Establish a complete and detailed project schedule for each project; a thoroughly documented scope of work for the project; and a project budget in accordance with Roeslein’s cost accounting system.
  • Plan for and secure any required subcontractors, including (but not limited to) engineers, consultants, fabricators, electrical and mechanical contractors, clerks, schedulers, administrative support, etc.
  • Implement bidding process for project subcontractors to obtain the most competitive prices.
  • Assist with negotiation and authorization of all terms and conditions of project subcontracts, and authorize subcontract changes.
  • Oversee, control and authorize all project-related expenditures.
  • Provide monthly project cost projections as compared with the project’s estimated budget; and monthly reports of project cost projections.
  • Present the contracted scope of work to the project team and ensure complete understanding and acceptance of responsibilities.
  • Provide thorough communication with the project team.
  • Travel domestically and internationally ranging from 10-50% per year and up to four (4) weeks duration.

OTHERS DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Promote a positive working environment in order to achieve the organization’s goals.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

Work is performed in an office and uncontrolled atmosphere. Exposure to harsh conditions—such as: dust, fumes, chemicals, hazardous materials, noise, and varying weather and temperatures—for short periods of time is possible. Must be able to travel to jobsites both domestically and internationally; living accommodations in some foreign assignments may not meet expected U.S. standards. All employees are required to follow safety standards and wear all personal protective equipment in designated areas.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to safely and successfully perform the essential responsibilities and functions of a Project Manager and are not meant to be all-inclusive. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential responsibilities and functions of the job.

KNOWLEDGE / SKILLS / EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering.
  • Courses in the area of Project Management.
  • Advanced English is mandatory.

OTHER DESIRABLE ATTRIBUTES:

  • It is preferred a minimum of Three (3) years of professional experience in a technically related field is required. It is strongly preferred that Two (2) years of that experience be as a Project Engineer.
  • A certified Project Management Professional (PMP) is preferred.
  • Demonstrated history of in strategic and tactical goal setting and attainment.
  • Excellent communication skills, both oral and written, and excellent presentation skills are required.
  • Strong organization, leadership, negotiation, and delegation skills are required.
  • Strong financial background including operations budget development, cost control, and capital spending justification.
  • Working knowledge of contract laws, jobsite safety procedures, and purchasing practices.
  • Specific estimating skills for engineering, construction management, and mechanical/electrical construction services is a must.
  • Working knowledge of common scheduling concepts such as CPM, PERT, Gantt charts, resource loading, etc.
  • Skilled in the use of scheduling software tools and must be able to create schedule reports for all audiences.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills are required.
  • Computer skills and an in-depth knowledge of Microsoft Windows based programs are required.
  • Requires effective time management skills, personal conduct, and change management abilities.
  • Must have a valid driver license.
  • Ability to effectively interact with co-workers, clients, vendors, and other business contacts.
  • Must comply with Roeslein & Associate’s core values for the safe and efficient operation of the business and maintain sound relationships among and with employees.

This is an in-person position, and applicants must be comfortable commuting to Arujá/SP. The role is primarily office-based, however, occasional travel to jobsites both domestically and internationally may be required.

description:
RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES
- Executar o processo de compra de produto junto ao fornecedor;
- Verificar a necessidade das lojas quanto à compra e entrega dos produtos;
- Auxiliar nos processos do setor de compras;
- Atender as necessidades das lojas para as dúvidas e dificuldades no que se refere à especificação de produtos, prazos de entrega e demais dúvidas técnicas;
- Alimentar e atualizar planilhas de dados que servirão de suporte para controle dos processos do setor;
- Realizar registro de informações pertinentes ao setor de compras;
- Cadastrar as lojas e fornecedores para o processo de compra e entrega dos produtos;
- Acompanhar prazo de entrega de pedidos enviados a fornecedores;
REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES
- Ensino Superior Completo ou em andamento em Administração, Economia, Engenharia e áreas correlatas;
- Conhecimento em Microsoft Office (Excel, Word e Power Point);
- Conhecimento em SAP;
- Experiência prévia no setor de Compras será considerado um diferencial.

Descontos em Instituições de Ensino

Nossa História:
Em 1967, inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Santo Cristo, um município pequeno do Estado do Rio Grande do Sul, mas que já abrigava nossos sonhos imensos. Com coragem e muito trabalho duro, fomos crescendo e levando cada vez mais qualidade para as famílias do interior gaúcho. Nosso objetivo desde o início foi estar ao lado das pessoas, seja no campo ou na cidade. Já nos anos 80, consolidamos o nosso portfólio de materiais de construção, eletrodomésticos e móveis, ficando conhecidos por oferecer uma solução integrada aos nossos consumidores. Nos anos 90, mais um salto de ousadia: agregamos a operação de serviços financeiros. O modelo deu certo e, nos anos 2000, foi expandido e consolidado definitivamente.
Em 2008 a companhia foi adquirida pelo fundo de Private Equity Advent International. Com essa mudança, o centro administrativo muda-se para a região metropolitana de Porto Alegre, no município de Cachoeirinha (RS).
Sempre buscando ir além, em 2010, chegamos em Santa Catarina e no Paraná, ampliando nossa presença em toda a região sul. Também nessa década, lançamos o Programa Palavra, nos tornando o único varejo do país a garantir o produto de graça se a entrega atrasar.
O ano de 2020 é marcado pela abertura de capital(IPO), na bolsa de valores brasileira, uma das maiores conquistas dos mais de cinquenta anos de história da organização.
Em agosto de 2021 marcamos presença em uma nova região do país, o Centro-Oeste, no Estado de Mato Grosso do Sul no município de Eldorado, e em novembro, a inauguramos a primeira loja em São Paulo na cidade de Osvaldo Cruz, dando a certeza de que muito além da venda de produtos para a casa e para a obra, e das soluções financeiras para o dia a dia, realizamos sonhos de muitas pessoas. E como somos inquietos desde o princípio de nossa história chegamos a mais um marco histórico dessa grande trajetória. Juntos, unimos o varejo físico com o virtual para oferecer infinitas oportunidades aos nossos clientes. A realização de um sonho: a Loja Infinita - uma conquista de quem constrói a nossa loja no dia a dia, com proximidade e paixão por atender bem.
Atualmente somos mais de 530 unidades de vendas em 5 Estados do Brasil. Além disso, contamos com 3 centros de distribuição e tudo isso só é possível, graças aos mais de 8.000 colaboradores que fazem parte desta história e sonham junto com a Quero-Quero.

No que acreditamos:
Somos uma organização que acredita que relacionamentos baseados em integridade, simplicidade, confiança e respeito são o que existe de mais importante. Nosso objetivo maior é proporcionar uma vida melhor aos nossos colaboradores, clientes e comunidades onde atuamos. Acreditamos que, ao viver isso com excelência, geraremos o valor e os resultados que nos proporcionarão crescimento constante e sustentável.

Nosso Jeito de Ser:
A cultura da Lojas Quero-Quero é formada por 10 valores que guiam todas as nossas decisões e comportamentos:
INTEGRIDADE
RESPEITO
SIMPLICIDADE
COMPROMETIMENTO
CONFIANÇA
TRANSPARÊNCIA
FOCO NAS PESSOAS
APRENDIZADO CONTÍNUO
TRABALHO EM EQUIPE
AUSTERIDADE
Somos uma equipe que vive estes valores, que se ajuda, e que encara a intensidade do nosso propósito todos os dias. Valorizamos histórias, perfis, vivências e opiniões por acreditar que as diferenças nos complementam e enriquecem a nossa história. Um time que valoriza a diversidade, unindo os diferentes talentos individuais para construímos juntos e juntas uma cultura do respeito, acolhimento e valorização.

Nossos Diferenciais:
Uma pessoa verdadeiramente Quero-Quero, busca equilibrar o compromisso, a verdade e a empatia para a construção da empresa dos sonhos. E a base de nosso relacionamento se dá através das nossas Verdades Fundamentais:
Prometa somente o que pode ser cumprido, mas cumpra tudo o que prometer, custe o que custar.
Fale sempre a verdade, sempre, doa a quem doer.
Faça aos outros o que você gostaria que fosse feito a você.

description:
Join to apply for the Graduate Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

3 days ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Graduate Customer Success Manager role at Canonical

The role of a Customer Success Manager at Canonical
Customer success is a new and strategic department at Canonical, with the objective to reduce risk and churn, facilitate the adoption of new products or services and support expansion within existing accounts. Customer Success Managers (CSM) are responsible for developing trust with their assigned customers and providing them with the best possible experience navigating Canonical's vast offering. Through a clear understanding of their customer's objectives, the CSM can activate a large range of internal and external capabilities to alleviate any pain point, align expectations, as well as help draw and deliver on an appropriate collaboration roadmap.
We are growing our Customer Success team to continue offering thoughtful, smart, precise interactions across our product portfolio, from Ubuntu to open source infrastructure and applications.
This role is a first step in the CSM organisation. Although you will primarily focus on the Tech segment, including the store customers, you will also have a portfolio assigned. Ubuntu is chosen by thousands of new users every month. Our responsibility is to ensure the best user experience for them through problem-solving, onboarding, enablement and value realisation all the way to success. Collaborating with other teams and participating in campaign efforts, you will connect with a diverse set of users of Canonical products and identify our future champions.
Location: This role will be based remotely worldwide.
What your day will look like

  • A strong focus on supporting customers by finding solutions to ticket requests.
  • Enrich documentation about problem solving, Q&A, onboarding materials.
  • Drive campaigns targeting multiple customers through digital touch-points and activities.
  • Identify high potential as well as high risk customers from newly onboarded users or customers
  • Onboard new customers and introduce them to our products and support processes. Products include: Ubuntu Pro, MAAS, Landscape, Openstack, Ceph, Kubernetes, data applications and many more.
  • Collaborate with Sales and Support in developing and delivering engagement plans that fulfill the customer's objectives.
  • Engage with your portfolio of customers to ensure risk identification
  • Collect feedback from customers and format them for review by the product team
What we are looking for in you
  • Customer-facing experience
  • An empathetic individual with a natural drive to help others
  • Passion for technology, infrastructure and Ubuntu in particular is a must
  • Excellent presentation skills
  • Strong organisational skills, ability to structure and constantly update documentation
  • A team player capable of interacting with all departments internally
Additional skills that you might also bring
  • We at the Customer Success team strongly appreciate various languages! Therefore, if you possess proficiency (both written and spoken) in Japanese, Korean, Spanish, Portuguese, German, French, or Italian, alongside an excellent command of English, please inform us!
What we offer you
We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.
  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues from your team and others
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical
Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.
Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.
Canonical is an equal opportunity employer
We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Job description

O QUE É SER MYRA?

É provocar a mudança com menos burocracia e mais coragem.

Ser Myra é saber ouvir e ser ouvido. É cuidar uns dos outros e cuidar do cliente. É entender que o aprendizado é a melhor parte da jornada. E é sempre querer saber mais. É transformar dados em conhecimento e com ele em mãos mudar o mundo.

*Para desempenhar bem essas atividades, um Analista de BI deve dominar ferramentas de visualização de dados e linguagens de programação, como Python e SQL. Além disso, é essencial ter uma orientação para negócios para alinhar as análises com os objetivos estratégicos da empresa.

Superior Completo ou Cursando nas áreas de Engenharia, Matemática, Estatística e áreas correlatas.

  1. Análise de Dados: Capacidade de interpretar grandes volumes de dados e extrair insights valiosos.

  10. Adaptabilidade e Aprendizado Contínuo: Flexibilidade para se adaptar a novas tecnologias e métodos.

Responsável pela execução de manutenção preventiva e corretiva, visando garantir o funcionamento de equipamentos e instalações, colaborando ao cumprimento das metas do Departamento de Manutenção da SBIB Hospital Israelita Albert Einstein.

Responsabilidades

  1. Executar manutenções preventivas e corretivas em equipamentos diversos e instalações, com exceção daqueles relacionados à alta potência e os alocados nas cabines primárias, secundárias, sistemas de geração e Nobreaks;

  10. Acompanhar processos de calibração de equipamentos;
  11. Vistoriar as subestações de medição e distribuição em Média e Baixa tensão;
  12. Realizar manutenção preventiva e corretiva em quadros elétricos de distribuição e comando;
  13. Atender aos chamados de manutenção e pequenas instalações;
  14. Participar de treinamentos e cursos conforme planejado;
  15. Atuar de forma humanizada na relação com o paciente, familiar e cliente interno, conforme Filosofia Planetree e diretrizes de qualidade e segurança do paciente;
  16. Conhecer os riscos dos locais de trabalho, cumprir e fazer cumprir os procedimentos, disposições legais, normas, instruções e políticas de Saúde, Segurança e Meio Ambiente;
  17. Usar a energia de forma racional.

Requisitos

  1. 2º Grau completo;
  2. Desejáveis Curso Técnico na área de atuação (pode estar Cursando para Manutenção Predial);

  5. SEP: Reciclagem Bianual (Exceto Manutenção Predial);
  6. Curso em informática (Pacote Office);
  7. Ter 01 ano de experiência.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza!

Nossa história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil.

Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore . Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos.

Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente .

Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce.

Job Summary

The Application Specialist is an experienced technical professional that provides support to IFF Pharma Solutions products and applications in Brazil, supporting all LATAM lab activity needed. He/She manages the technical relationship with specific pharmaceutical and dietary supplement customers in support of growing the business and developing a robust pipeline of opportunities.

The Pharma Solutions business will be taking on its next chapter of growth as a trusted partner for the pharmaceutical industry with the announcement to sell Pharma Solutions to Roquette. This move will position Pharma Solutions to expand its industry leadership through continued investment in innovation to meet the evolving needs of pharmaceutical manufacturers and developers worldwide. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2025, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. The Pharma Solutions business unit will remain a part of IFF until close and, at such time, it will transition to Roquette. In applying for this position, you acknowledge your awareness that the position is a part of the Pharma Solutions business unit and has been identified to transition to Roquette.

Responsibilities:

Technical Expertise on Established Products and Applications:

  • Contribute to/lead creative application approaches utilizing IFF’s excipients via generation of ideas and concepts to meet current and anticipated customer needs and to offer strong alternatives to competitive products.
  • Be the technical expert in IFF’s Pharmaceutical and Dietary Supplement excipient products Portfolio and its applications, providing hands-on/classroom training to Customers, Sales, Marketing, and Distributors, as appropriate. Publish conference posters, papers, and articles.
  • Support the commercialization of new technologies and/or products through voice-of-customer and application/customer trials.
  • Develop product data, applications, value-in-use information, product literature, and sales presentations.
  • Evaluate, develop data for, and assist in introducing new products.
  • Perform failure analysis and determine root cause/corrective action.

Strategic Market Support:

  • Collaborate with Strategic and Field Marketing in identifying global trends that could result in new opportunities or risks for IFF Pharma Solutions and translate those into appropriate application or product concepts.
  • Identify unmet customer and industry needs to accelerate growth such as specific technical support and services.
  • Effectively share learnings gained with other application, regional, and global teams.

Leadership:

  • Work closely with Marketing, Sales, and Distributors to ensure high-quality knowledge of our products and applications are communicated via training and demonstrations.
  • Act as a member of the global IFF Applications team to communicate regularly around successful Application projects and leverage learnings from other regions.

Project Management:

  • Develop and manage self-initiated or assigned Application/R&D projects and Customer Technical Service Requests (TSRs), and liaise with other Regional Labs to ensure timely completion and appropriate prioritization in alignment with Business needs.
  • Design experiments and testing protocols, and work with regional labs to coordinate bench work to support project goals.
  • Write Technical Reports and ensure confidential information is properly safeguarded throughout the course of project work.
  • Contribute to maintaining, improving, and advancing technical capabilities in line with current and future business needs and developments.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor's Degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or Life Sciences is required.
  • 5-10 years of Pharmaceutical formulation and technical service or product development experience, which should include hands-on experience with formulating tablets, capsules, and/or gummies with experience in lab to pilot-scale blending, granulation, tableting, coating, and similar processes. Must be able to demonstrate practical familiarity with relevant equipment such as rotary tablet machines, fluid-bed granulator/coaters, encapsulation machines, gummy depositing equipment, and film coating equipment.
  • Highly collaborative and an effective communicator.
  • Skilled at building relationships and adapting messages for diverse audiences.
  • Dedicated to addressing customer needs, delivering solutions that meet customer expectations, and skilled in managing complexity.
  • Demonstrates decisive execution capabilities.
  • Advanced competency in science-based innovation.
  • Ability to fuse technical competency with the commercial aspects of the business.
  • Can balance the interests of multiple internal and external stakeholders.
  • A willingness to travel if needed (20%).

Preferred Experience:

  • Demonstration of ability to lead/manage a product from R&D to manufacturing.
  • A broad overview of the technical/regulatory requirements and trends for the pharmaceutical industry.
  • A good understanding of related functional areas of a pharmaceutical company (e.g., analytical, clinical trials, production, QA, regulatory affairs).
  • Familiarity with the Dietary Supplement industry is preferred.

Preferred Education:

  • An MBA or MS/PhD in a relevant discipline, such as Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or Life Sciences, is strongly preferred.
  • English intermediate is needed.

description:
Paymentology is the first truly global issuer-processor, giving banks and fintechs the technology, team and experience to rapidly issue and process Mastercard, Visa and UnionPay cards across more than 60 countries, at scale.

Our advanced, multi-cloud platform, offering both shared and dedicated processing instances, vast global presence and richer, real-time data, set us apart as the leader in payments.

We’re looking for a Senior Profitability and Costing Manager (Engineering/Cloud) to lead Paymentology's cost analysis and commercial finance strategy. In this role, you will develop robust costing models, analyse cost-to-serve, and collaborate with cross-functional teams to support informed decision-making.

This is a high-impact position requiring strong technical acumen , particularly in infrastructure-intensive environments , and the ability to translate complex financial insights into clear, actionable recommendations. You’ll play a key role in financial planning, infrastructure cost assessments, and marginal profitability modelling, helping shape pricing strategies that align with our long-term goals.

We’re looking for a highly analytical, detail-oriented professional who can implement scalable financial models, benchmark industry best practices, and enhance profitability tracking through automation and data-driven insights.

If you're passionate about leveraging data to optimise financial performance and drive impactful decision-making, we’d love to hear from you!

Tasks

Cost & Profitability Analysis : Develop an in-depth understanding of Paymentology’s global cost-to-serve and infrastructure setup. Define standard costing models and maintain data-driven estimates for transaction and customer onboarding costs. Collaborate across teams to ensure accurate measurement of resources and effort for each product, platform, and service.

Financial Modelling & Reporting : Create technically robust profitability models to ensure desired margins and strong unit economics. Generate detailed profitability reports and automate tracking for scalability. Prepare clear presentations to communicate Paymentology’s financial performance to senior stakeholders.

Industry Benchmarking & Process Improvement : Benchmark Paymentology's commercial finance practices against industry best-in-class standards. Identify opportunities to enhance profitability and operational efficiency. Work with the Pricing Manager to optimise pricing strategies.

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement : Partner with cross-functional teams to align financial strategies with business goals. Provide actionable financial insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, supporting key decision-making.

Requirements

What it takes to succeed:

  • 10+ years of experience in finance, specifically on costing and pricing, within a large-scale, infrastructure-intensive technology business or engineering projects.
  • Proven track record of developing financial models, implementing costing processes, and driving profitability improvements at scale.
  • Strong technical understanding of cloud infrastructure setup and engineering project costing.
  • Experience in issuer processing or payments is advantageous.
  • Proven expertise in financial modelling, profitability analysis, and cost allocation strategies.
  • Extensive experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, particularly within infrastructure and technology domains.
  • Experience in automation and system-driven approaches to financial reporting and cost management.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present financial concepts to senior leadership with confidence and clarity.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to identifying efficiency opportunities.
  • Collaborative team player committed to driving results in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Educational background in Engineering preferred.

This is a hybrid role based in London.

At Paymentology we value making a difference to the lives of the people who work for us and who live in the communities where we operate. You can look forward to working with a diverse, global team where Paymentologists at all levels play an important part in our global mission to advance the world through payments and make a difference on a global scale.

title: ESPECIALISTA EM BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE
description:
Job description

A Funcional Health Tech acredita que a saúde é o pilar principal da vida das pessoas, por isso buscamos inovar e promover a saúde de forma sustentável, quebrando barreiras.

Para realizar nosso propósito, inovamos todos os dias, unindo pessoas, tecnologia e dados para oferecer soluções que gerem eficiência e sustentabilidade em toda a cadeia do ecossistema da saúde.

Aqui, você participará, de forma direta ou indireta, da criação de novas soluções para diversos serviços de saúde, pois essa é a missão diária de todos nós na Funcional. Pesquisamos, criamos e fazemos acontecer, pois isso faz parte do nosso DNA.

Main responsibilities

Sua missão como Especialista em Business Intelligence será:

  • Reformular e estruturar os acompanhamentos de performance existentes, criando dashboards, relatórios e rotinas analíticas mais escaláveis ;
  • Conduzir análises exploratórias e diagnósticas sobre resultados comerciais, comportamento da base de clientes e atuação do time Hunter;
  • Apoiar a definição e o monitoramento de indicadores estratégicos (KPIs), contribuindo para a priorização de oportunidades e a definição de metas comerciais;
  • Atuar de forma consultiva e provocadora , sendo um ponto de apoio estratégico para o Coordenador de Planejamento Comercial e demais stakeholders do negócio;
  • Participar de reuniões e fóruns estratégicos, trazendo uma visão analítica e de negócios para decisões comerciais;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia de Dados, Comercial, Produto e Marketing, promovendo o cruzamento inteligente de dados e o uso eficiente de informações;
  • Automatizar processos de coleta e visualização de dados sempre que possível, otimizando o tempo da equipe.

Requirements and skills

Habilidades que esperamos que você possua:

  • Sólida experiência em BI, planejamento comercial, inteligência de mercado ou áreas correlatas;
  • Perfil híbrido: forte capacidade analítica aliada à visão de negócio e ótima comunicação com públicos não técnicos;
  • Vivência com Power BI , SQL e Python para análises e automações;
  • Capacidade de gerar insights estratégicos e provocar discussões a partir de dados;
  • Desejável experiência em empresas com perfil data-driven (como fintechs, healthtechs, edtechs ou grandes operações comerciais);
  • Postura proativa, curiosa e provocadora , com foco em alavancas de resultado.

Diferenciais que vão fazer você chamar nossa atenção:

  • Experiência prévia em ambientes B2B;
  • Conhecimento em modelos de carteira orgânica e estratégias de expansão comercial;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de analytics.

Additional information

Como é trabalhar aqui na Funcional Health Tech:

  • Nosso time é incrível, colaboramos e fazemos juntos para ir mais longe.
  • Nossa cultura é ágil e estamos em constante evolução.
  • Incentivamos o crescimento profissional e o desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores com diversas ações e encontros, através de plataforma de treinamentos e webinars mensais, além da “Baratona”, que é o nosso Hackathon interno.

A Funcional reconhece que a diversidade traz benefícios para o negócio e que um ambiente plural e colaborativo é propício para a inovação acontecer. Desta forma, nossas oportunidades abraçam todos os talentos, sem distinção de cor, raça, gênero ou qualquer condição de deficiência. Todos os talentos podem participar igualitariamente nos processos seletivos da Funcional. Venha fazer parte do nosso time!

A C&A é uma das maiores redes de varejo de moda no mundo. De origem holandesa, foi fundada em 1841 pelos irmãos Clemens e August, cuja união das iniciais de seus nomes resultou na marca C&A. Nessa trajetória de sucesso, em 1976 foi inaugurada a primeira loja no Brasil, no Shopping Ibirapuera, em São Paulo. Atualmente, a C&A está presente em todos os estados do território nacional com mais de 330 lojas. Claro que, desde a sua primeira unidade, muita coisa mudou, mas a filosofia de trabalho continua a mesma: entendemos as pessoas, suas necessidades, evoluções, sua relação com a moda e as tendências, e traduzimos isso em uma experiência vibrante e completa. Esse é o nosso jeito de criar combinações para impulsionar e inspirar o pertencimento de cada pessoa.

title: Business IT Systems Analyst
description:
About the Role

As a Business Analyst at TD SYNNEX, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to understand business needs, drive technology solutions, and optimize operational systems. You will lead efforts to elicit, analyze, and document user requirements, translating them into functional specifications for development teams. Your work will directly support impactful decisions, enhance systems, and strengthen our organizational efficiency.

This is a role for individuals passionate about bridging business and technology to drive inclusive, scalable solutions.

What You'll Do:

  • Partner with project managers and stakeholders to define scope, priorities, and user needs.

  • Identify and understand diverse user classes and their unique requirements.

  • Gather insights through interviews, surveys, workshops, and data analysis.

  • Translate business needs into clear, actionable functional and technical requirements.

  • Lead or support design sessions, develop interface prototypes, and support system design.

  • Analyze, validate, and document requirements, ensuring consistency and feasibility.

  • Develop visual tools such as diagrams, charts, and process flows to clarify complex systems.

  • Support and lead user testing efforts; coordinate with QA and Training teams.

  • Recommend solutions based on ROI, cost-benefit, and system efficiency analyses.

  • Monitor and report on requirement lifecycle status; communicate changes clearly.

  • Support knowledge sharing by mentoring junior team members and facilitating system orientation.

What We're Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in business analysis or related areas.

  • Effective communication skills in English and Portuguese are required . Spanish language skills are highly desirable and will support broader collaboration in the LATAM region

  • Experience supporting software/system development and implementation projects.

  • Strong analytical, statistical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to create inclusive, user-friendly documentation and translate technical concepts for non-technical audiences.

  • Proficiency in SQL (MySQL, Vertica preferred), Power BI, and data analysis tools.

  • Knowledge of project management software (e.g., MS Project).

  • Basic familiarity with scripting languages and operating systems is a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally with diverse teams and adapt to culturally varied environments.

  • A customer-centric mindset and strong commitment to collaboration, integrity, and innovation.

Working Conditions

  • Hybrid Model : Flexible mix of remote and in-office work, supporting work-life balance.

  • Inclusive Culture : We are committed to fostering a welcoming, respectful, and equitable environment for all.

  • Professional Growth : Join a global organization that values learning, development, and internal mobility.

  • Team Collaboration : Engage with colleagues across borders and departments, leveraging diverse experiences to achieve common goals.

Key Skills

Data Analysis, Data Analytics, Microsoft Power Business Intelligence (BI), MySQL, Project Management, Structured Query Language (SQL)

What’s In It For You?

  • Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.
  • Grow Your Career: Accelerate your path to success (and keep up with the future) with formal programs on leadership and professional development, and many more on-demand courses.
  • Elevate Your Personal Well-Being: Boost your financial, physical, and mental well-being through seminars, events, and our global Life Empowerment Assistance Program.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: It’s not just a phrase to us; valuing every voice is how we succeed. Join us in celebrating our global diversity through inclusive education, meaningful peer-to-peer conversations, and equitable growth and development opportunities.
  • Make the Most of our Global Organization : Network with other new co-workers within your first 30 days through our onboarding program.
  • Connect with Your Community: Participate in internal, peer-led inclusive communities and activities, including business resource groups, local volunteering events, and more environmental and social initiatives.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.

At TD SYNNEX, we’re proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you’re excited about working for our company and believe you’re a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we’re looking for!

Local : SP - Escritório Faria Lima, híbrido flexível.
Responsabilidades e atribuições
COMO SERÁ O SEU DIA A DIA:

  • Definição e gestão de Arquitetura Corporativa;
  • Manter a gestão de conhecimento sobre as aplicações e a maturidade (ciclo de vida de produtos);
  • Participação ativa no roadmap de migração para Cloud da Raízen conduzido pela frente de Soluções de Infraestrutura;

Requisitos e qualificações
O QUE VOCÊ PRECISA TER:
  • Graduação completa (bacharelado), preferencialmente em áreas de Informática e/ou Engenharia;
  • Vivência sólida com práticas estruturadas de Enterprise Architecture, correspondente ao nível gerencial;
  • Atuação consistente no uso de frameworks de EA (The Open Group Architectural Framework, The Zachman Framework for Enterprise Architecture, Federal Enterprise Architecture Framework ou Gartner);
  • Sólida experiência em definição, construção e transformação de empresas e migrações de Data Centers on premises para Cloud em empresas de médio ou grande porte;
  • Experiência comprovada com arquitetura de aplicação, integração, dados e tecnológica empregadas à resolução de necessidades de negócio;
  • Experiência comprovada em infraestruturas de redes, segurança e desenvolvimento de aplicações;
  • Experiência consolidada e excelente comunicação, apresentação e negociação com diferentes equipes, pares, equipes técnicas, gestores, executivos e órgãos reguladores/auditores;
  • Profissional sênior e resiliente para saber gerir situações de conflitos e conseguir estabelecer ótimos relacionamentos com demais áreas de TI e áreas de negócios da Raízen;
  • Habilidade em influenciar tipos e níveis diferentes de audiências;
  • Inglês fluente (ou nível avançado para conversação e apresentações, bem como leitura e escrita).

Nosso processo contempla 3 etapas principais (podem ter outras, e você ficará por dentro caso avance):

description:
Senior Design System Designer - SAP Concur

At SAP, we enable you to bring out your best. Our company culture is focused on collaboration and a shared passion to help the world run better. How? We focus every day on building the foundation for tomorrow and creating a workplace that embraces differences, values flexibility, and is aligned to our purpose-driven and future-focused work. We offer a highly collaborative, caring team environment with a strong focus on learning and development, recognition for your individual contributions, and a variety of benefit options for you to choosefrom.

Join SAP Concur’s Design Systems team and help shape the future of scalable, accessible enterprise experiences. Move beyond maintaining a component library — architect how global teams design, build, and innovate across multiple SAP product areas.
You’ll create foundational patterns and practices that empower product teams worldwide to deliver exceptional experiences, improving how people travel, work, and manage expenses.

WHAT YOU'LL DO:

In this role, you will:

  • Shape and grow a multi-platform design system used by millions globally.
  • Design foundational components, patterns, and floorplans that streamline complex enterprise experiences.
  • Drive cross-functional collaboration with designers, engineers, and product managers worldwide.
  • Champion inclusive, accessible, and human-centered design practices at every level.
  • Mentor teams to create with quality, speed, and purpose while promoting design system best practices.
  • Analyze system usage and feedback (both quantitative and qualitative) to guide continuous improvements.
  • Educate and advocate across the organization to promote system adoption and scale impact.
  • Deliver measurable impact by simplifying complex systems, making them intuitive, empowering, and accessible for users everywhere.

KEY RESPONSABILITIES:

  • Design System Leadership: Develop, evolve, and maintain a scalable, enterprise-grade design system supporting multiple products and platforms.
  • Component, Pattern, and Floorplan Design: Specify reusable UI components, UX patterns, and page-level floorplans with deep documentation and accessibility baked in.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with global designers, framework developers, product managers, and stakeholders to ensure smooth system implementation.
  • Accessibility and Inclusivity: Embed WCAG accessibility standards and inclusive design principles throughout every system element.
  • Education and Evangelism: Create training, documentation, workshops, and internal communication to increase system literacy and adoption.
  • Data-Driven Continuous Improvement: Evaluate feedback and usage data to prioritize and deliver high-impact system enhancements.
  • Mentorship and Support: Guide designers in system thinking, provide hands-on support for product teams, and cultivate a culture of design excellence.
  • Quality and Standards Stewardship: Maintain the highest quality standards for system assets and ensure consistent, scalable UX across SAP Concur platforms.

WHAT YOU BRING:

  • Proven experience building, evolving, and scaling enterprise-grade design systems across web and mobile platforms.
  • Deep systems thinking and expertise in designing scalable UI/UX foundations for complex products.
  • Strong collaboration skills working across global, multidisciplinary teams.
  • Expertise specifying and documenting components and patterns within Figma (or equivalent tools).
  • Deep commitment to accessibility (WCAG 2.1/2.2) and inclusive design.

KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Design: Visual, Graphic, Interface, Industrial, Media, or related fields

title: Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais
description:
Estamos muito felizes por saber que você se interessou em embarcar em uma grande jornada aqui no Grupo EP, e para isso é muito importante que conheça um pouco mais sobre nós:

  • Oferecemos soluções ambientais personalizadas com expertise técnica superior, através de tecnologias avançadas e transparência no relacionamento com clientes. Nosso objetivo é garantir sustentabilidade e resultados de qualidade, atendendo às demandas ambientais mais desafiadoras.
  • Estamos entre as 5 maiores empresas em tratamento de água e análises ambientais no país, com 50 anos de existência .
  • Visamos o cuidado e respeito ao meio ambiente, com isso tivemos mais de 660 milhões de m³ de efluentes tratados por nossos clientes até hoje (o equivalente ao consumo de água da população do estado de SP, 12 milhões de pessoas, durante um ano).
  • Nosso maior objetivo é a expansão da nossa organização; em 2033, nossa meta é expandir nossa atuação no Brasil, e para isso contamos com um time de 500 colaboradores distribuídos nas 5 frentes de atuação da EP.

Temos quatro valores que regem nossos direcionamentos e atuação na EP, que são:

  • Paixão por aprender: Aqui valorizamos, incentivamos e investimos pesado em educação. Somos uma empresa que presta serviço, ou seja, vendemos o conhecimento do nosso time, e por isso oferecemos diversas maneiras para que você tenha acesso aos melhores cursos e se desenvolva profissionalmente.
  • Falo e faço: É o valor que garante um ambiente íntegro e coerente entre o discurso e as ações. Transparência e honestidade são essenciais em qualquer relação dentro e fora da EP, com colaboradores, clientes, fornecedores e comunidade.
  • Visto a camisa: Para termos sucesso no mercado e qualidade em cada serviço que fornecemos, valorizamos que nossos colaboradores estejam alinhados com nosso propósito e possam exercer suas funções em sua totalidade e com segurança.
  • Hoje melhor que ontem: Acreditamos que, se todos buscarem fazer hoje algo melhor do que fizeram ontem, visando melhoria contínua, seremos uma empresa melhor a cada dia também. Para nós, qualidade é nosso combustível que nos mantém ativos.

Se você, assim como nós, também é movido à água e quer fazer a diferença no mundo, vem com a gente!

Missão do cargo: Limpeza nas instalações e manutenção dos gramados (corte de grama da ETE).

Como será seu dia a dia:

  • Manter os ambientes da unidade limpos e organizados.
  • Zelar pela guarda, conservação, manutenção, higiene e limpeza dos equipamentos, instrumentos e demais materiais utilizados.
  • Cuidar e manter a área verde (gramado) organizada.

Pré-requisitos para essa função:

  • Ensino médio completo
  • Desejável conhecimento em manutenção de área verde.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Participar dos treinamentos e diálogos de segurança oferecidos
  • Conservar seu local de trabalho e EPIs com limpeza e organização
  • Colaborar com o time no atingimento de objetivos do setor
  • Realizar feedbacks trimestrais com seu superior direto
  • Buscar aplicar nossos valores no dia a dia dentro e fora da EP
  • Comprometimento e ética junto ao time e cliente

Informações gerais:

O Grupo EP foi fundado em 1974 com a missão de garantir que o meio ambiente seja preservado, as leis ambientais sejam cumpridas e possamos deixar um lugar melhor para as futuras gerações viverem.

Identificamos e solucionamos problemas relacionados a tratamento de água e efluentes, reuso, dessalinização e análises ambientais para indústrias, consultorias ambientais e concessionárias de saneamento.

About the Opportunity:

The Senior Audit Manager, FinCrime (LACC) will manage the internal audit function for financial crimes, including Anti-Money Laundering (AML), Counter-Terrorist Financing (CTF), sanctions compliance, fraud prevention, and other financial crime-related activities. This role ensures that the organization's financial crime risk management and compliance frameworks are robust, effective, and aligned with regulatory expectations.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Strategic Leadership

  • Develop and implement the annual audit plan for financial crimes, ensuring alignment with the organization's strategic goals and regulatory requirements.
  • Advise senior management on financial crime-related risks, control gaps, and regulatory trends.
  • Act as a subject matter expert for financial crimes audit, providing strategic insights and guidance.
2. Audit Execution
  • Lead end-to-end audits covering AML/CTF, sanctions compliance, fraud detection, and other financial crime programs.
  • Assess the effectiveness of policies, procedures, controls, and systems designed to mitigate financial crime risks.
  • Monitor compliance with local and global regulatory requirements (e.g., AML, FATF, OFAC sanctions, etc.).
  • Ensure that audits are conducted efficiently, with clear and actionable recommendations provided to management.
3. Team Management
  • Foster and contribute to a culture of collaboration, excellence, and continuous improvement within the audit team.
  • Coordinate with colleagues located globally, as well the potential to manage performance of small teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality audit reports.
4. Stakeholder Management
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including Compliance,Risk Management, Legal, and external regulators.
  • Participate in governance forums, presenting audit findings and updates related to financial crimes risk.
  • Provide proactive insights into emerging financial crime risks and regulatory changes.
5. Regulatory and Industry Knowledge
  • Stay up to date with regulatory developments, industry best practices, and emerging threats in financial crime risk management.
  • Ensure the organization's financial crime audit approach aligns with regulatory expectations and global standards.
6. Reporting
  • Prepare and deliver comprehensive, timely, and accurate audit work papers and reports to senior management and the Audit Committee.
  • Track and validate the remediation of audit findings to ensure timely resolution.
What We're Looking For:

Experience: Strong experience (8+ years) in internal audit, including leadership roles in Financial Crimes at a leading global financial institution, fintech, or Big 4 firm. Experience in crypto, digital assets, or blockchain is a plus..

Expertise: Deep knowledge of AML, CTF, and sanctions regulatory expectations for financial services, and cutting-edge audit methodologies. Familiarity with data analytics and emerging audit technologies is highly desirable

Leadership: Proven ability to lead and inspire cross-functional teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Communication: Exceptional ability to articulate complex ideas to diverse audiences, including regulators and senior leadership

Certifications: ACAMS required.CPA, CIA, or similar credentials are also preferred. Advanced certifications (e.g., CISA, CFA) are a plus.

Education: Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field. Law degree or equivalent preferred.

title: AFESU contrata pessoa gerente de Relacionamento Institucional
description:
A Associação Feminina de Estudos Sociais e Universitários (AFESU), uma das primeiras organizações sociais do Brasil a atuar com educação e qualificação profissional 100% gratuita e exclusiva para mulheres, de 8 a 24 anos, está contratando uma pessoa Gerente de Relacionamento Institucional I. A pessoa profissional será responsável por desenvolver e implementar estratégias de captação de recursos com foco em empresas e pessoas físicas, garantindo a sustentabilidade financeira da AFESU e maximizando seu impacto. Conheça a vaga:

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES | ATRIBUIÇÕES

Desenvolvimento e Implementação de Estratégias:

  1. Criar e executar um plano estratégico de captação de recursos alinhado com os objetivos gerais da AFESU, focado tanto em hunting quanto farming de empresas e pessoas físicas;
  2. Monitorar tendências e identificar novas oportunidades de financiamento, incluindo parcerias corporativas, doações recorrentes e grandes doadores;
  3. Participar e contribuir ativamente no time da liderança no estabelecimento de estratégias e discussões gerais da AFESU.

Gestão de Equipes:
  1. Liderar e apoiar as duas coordenadoras de captação de recursos, garantindo que suas equipes estejam motivadas, bem treinadas e alinhadas com os objetivos da organização;
  2. Facilitar a colaboração e sinergia entre as equipes de captação PJ e PF para maximizar o impacto da área;
  3. Realizar a manutenção do relacionamento saudável com as interfaces chave dentro da AFESU.

Relacionamento com Parceiros/Doadores:
  1. Desenvolver e manter relacionamentos sólidos com doadores existentes e potenciais, incluindo a criação de programas de reconhecimento e retenção;
  2. Representar a AFESU em eventos e reuniões com stakeholders chave, assegurando que a organização seja vista como um parceiro de confiança e impacto;
  3. Acompanhar o lançamento de editais e leis de incentivo que a AFESU possa beneficiar seus programas/projetos.

Gestão Orçamentária e Relatórios:
  1. Criar e gerenciar o orçamento da área de captação de recursos, garantindo o uso eficiente dos recursos e o alcance das metas financeiras;
  2. Elaborar relatórios regulares para a CEO e o conselho, destacando o progresso, desafios e oportunidades na captação de recursos;

Inovação e Melhoria Contínua:
  1. Introduzir novas ideias e abordagens para a captação de recursos, utilizando tecnologias emergentes e práticas de mercado inovadoras;
  2. Avaliar constantemente o desempenho das iniciativas de captação e ajustar estratégias conforme necessário para garantir resultados ótimos.

REQUISITOS | COMPETÊNCIAS DESEJÁVEIS

  1. Experiência mínima de 4 anos em captação de recursos, preferencialmente em organizações sociais ou ONGs;
  2. Histórico de sucesso em captação de recursos de empresas e de pessoas físicas;
  3. Excelentes habilidades de comunicação, apresentação e relacionamento;
  4. Capacidade de liderar e inspirar equipes, promovendo um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e orientado para resultados;
  5. Forte entendimento do setor social e compromisso com a missão da AFESU;
  6. Habilidade em gestão de projetos e orçamentos;
  7. Formação superior em áreas relacionadas (Administração, Marketing, Comunicação, etc.);
  8. Inglês e Pacote Office: Nível Avançado.

FAIXA SALARIAL | BENEFÍCIOS

Híbrido com trabalho presencial duas vezes na semana (São Paulo – SP)
