description:
Join to apply for the Sr. Regional Marketing Manager (LATAM) role at Neo4j

Join to apply for the Sr. Regional Marketing Manager (LATAM) role at Neo4j

Neo4j is the leader in Graph Database & Analytics, helping organizations uncover hidden patterns and relationships across billions of data connections deeply, easily, and quickly. Customers use Neo4j to gain a deeper understanding of their business and reveal new ways of solving their most pressing problems. Over 84% of Fortune 100 companies use Neo4j, along with a vibrant community of 250,000+ developers, data scientists, and architects across the globe.

At Neo4j, we’re proud to build the technology that powers breakthrough solutions for our customers. These solutions have helped NASA get to Mars two years earlier, broke the Panama Papers for the ICIJ, and are helping Transport for London to cut congestion by 10% and save $750M a year. Some of our other notable customers include Intuit, Lockheed Martin, Novartis, UBS, and Walmart.

Neo4j experienced rapid growth this year as organizations looking to deploy generative AI (GenAI) recognized graph databases as essential for improving it’s accuracy, transparency, and explainability. Growth was further fueled by enterprise demand for Neo4j’s cloud offering and partnerships with leading cloud hyperscalers and ecosystem leaders. Learn more at neo4j.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

Our Vision

At Neo4j, we have always strived to help the world make sense of data.

As business, society and knowledge become increasingly connected, our technology promotes innovation by helping organizations to find and understand data relationships. We created, drive and lead the graph database category, and we’re disrupting how organizations leverage their data to innovate and stay competitive.

JOB TITLE: Sr. Regional Marketing Manager (LATAM)

Location : Ideally based in or near São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, OR Miami, FL ,. Travel will be required especially if based outside of São Paulo.

Job Description

Role Overview

As a key driver of revenue growth in our LATAM region, particularly in Brazil, you will play a pivotal role in achieving our ambitious revenue targets. We are seeking a strategic and results-oriented Senior Regional Marketing Manager (RMM) who can craft and execute high-impact marketing strategies and demand generation programs that align with regional pipeline and revenue objectives.

Reporting Structure

The Senior RMM will be an integral member of our Americas Marketing team, reporting directly to the VP of Americas Marketing. This role requires building robust partnerships with the Neo4j LATAM sales team and collaborating effectively with various departments, including corporate marketing, digital, developer relations, communications (PR), and product marketing, to drive business success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Development: Formulate and execute the comprehensive marketing strategy for the LATAM region, incorporating digital marketing, partnerships, public relations (in collaboration with an agency and the communications team), account-based marketing (ABM), and event initiatives aimed at generating leads, opportunities, and deals.
  • Performance Accountability: Lead the execution and optimization of the marketing mix to meet key performance indicators, including Marketing Qualified Leads (MQLs) and Sales Accepted Opportunities (SAOs). Continuously evaluate and report on the effectiveness of marketing programs to enhance execution, efficiency, and overall results.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work collaboratively across all marketing functions to design and implement effective lead generation programs, encompassing digital initiatives, corporate events, and webinars.
  • Event Coordination: Define and implement LATAM-specific events and demand generation programs, including owned events, roadshows, workshops, and participation in third-party conferences. This includes audience segmentation, registration management, promotion, lead handling, and outcome tracking.
  • Channel Partnership: Cultivate and expand engagement with regional channel partners (GCP and AWS) through joint marketing initiatives.
  • Sales Development Partnership: Work closely with Sales Development teams to gather feedback, ensuring timely and effective follow-up on leads.
  • Strategic Communication: Effectively communicate marketing strategies, value propositions, positioning, and messaging to the LATAM sales team, ensuring they are equipped with the latest, most compelling content for effective sales cycles.
  • PR: Assist in facilitating customer and press participation in local activities, including press releases, case studies, event presentations, and industry awards.

Who You'll Work With

You’ll be a key member of the Americas Regional Marketing team. The team is responsible for driving the highest quality lead generation programs that take customers and prospects through their buyers’ journey using all activities in the marketing mix including digital, partner and event programs.

As a Senior Regional Marketer, you will drive opportunities and pipeline growth by developing and executing on a quarterly marketing plan based on approved budgets. You’ll recommend digital programs, specific regional activities and local events, and determine what demand generation content needs will drive business results for the region. This position requires significant cross-functional collaboration.

Who You Are

  • Languages: Fluency in both Brazilian Portuguese and English is required for this role. While not required, proficiency in Spanish is considered a strong plus.
  • 7+ years in Regional Marketing, with a proven track record in developing and executing pipeline-generation programs, digital initiatives, and events. Experience with Account-Based Marketing (ABM) is a plus.
  • 5+ years collaborating on PR and thought leadership strategies for regional growth.
  • Strong demand generation expertise, analytical abilities, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proven experience in event planning, execution, and post-event analysis.
  • Exceptional communication and influencing skills, effective at all organizational levels.
  • Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively, partnering with internal teams and external vendors to meet goals.
  • Goal-oriented self-starter with a proactive, independent work style who thrives in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to lead projects from concept to completion.
  • Strategic thinker with the ability to work at both the tactical and strategic levels, including effective budget management and ROI optimization.
  • Technical Proficiency: Advanced knowledge of Marketo, Tableau and Salesforce is essential.

About Us

Zurich Insurance Company is a leading provider of insurance products and services, committed to delivering innovative solutions and exceptional customer service. Our ZCAM (Zurich Customer Active Management) team turns customer data into practical business solutions to drive the implementation of our ambitious customer strategy.

About the Role

If you are a talented, dynamic, and experienced Data Analyst passionate about connecting the dots and have a strong background in technology, we would love to hear from you.

The opportunity: DATA ANALYST

As a Business Analyst, you will help ZCAM’s customers by understanding their needs and developing solutions to business problems. You will work with multidisciplinary and international teams to gather requirements, document processes, and communicate findings. Your responsibilities include collecting and documenting business needs, analyzing data for trends and insights, suggesting process improvements, creating reports and presentations for stakeholders, and collaborating with teams to implement solutions. You will also ensure project objectives align with business goals and lead meetings and workshops to drive project success. Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Understand customer objectives, processes, and products to make appropriate recommendations during incubation, delivery, and operations.
  • Plan, conduct, and facilitate sessions for gathering business requirements with subject matter experts and end users.
  • Determine the best delivery methodology for each project.
  • Contribute to business cases, including cost/benefit analysis, risk assessment, project scope, and high-level scheduling.
  • Produce requirement specifications and solution design documents throughout the project lifecycle, incorporating change requests.
  • Analyze and manage requirement risks, traceability, and prioritization.
  • Perform quality reviews on project deliverables.
  • Participate in testing, implementation, and training activities.
  • Engage in post-implementation activities, including problem-solving and benefits measurement.
  • Communicate effectively across different mediums and levels.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, engineering, science, or related fields; higher degrees are a plus.
  • Relevant professional experience or demonstrated competency in related roles/projects.
  • Balanced business acumen with technological and system understanding.
  • Innovative, motivated, business and IT savvy.
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks and deadlines independently.
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail.
  • Experience delivering business solutions on time, within budget, and with quality.
  • Proven experience as a business analyst or subject matter expert in global projects or insurance business.
  • Knowledge of project management and software development methodologies (e.g., Agile, SCRUM, ITIL, PMP).
  • Flexible, determined, and results-oriented.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills.
  • Experience in application testing and user acceptance testing organization.
  • Customer-oriented team player with effective collaboration skills.
  • Proficiency in English and Portuguese; Spanish skills are a plus.

Additional Information

We look forward to your online application. Zurich considers flexible working arrangements and does not provide relocation or work permit assistance for this role.

title: Data Protection Analyst (1785)
description:
Join Our Team at Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC

At Hy Cite Enterprises, LLC, we are proud to be a global leader and innovator in the direct selling industry, with more than 50 years of sustained growth and meaningful impact across 7 countries.

Our people are the heart of our success. We embrace the unique experiences, cultural backgrounds, and perspectives that each team member brings—because we know that diversity drives innovation and connection. By fostering an inclusive environment built on trust, support, and authenticity, we’re able to better understand and serve our distributors and customers around the world.

We are looking for our next: Data Protection Analyst in Barueri, São Paulo, Brazil

What The Role Involves

The Data Protection Analyst will be a valued collaborator across Legal, IT, and Information Security functions, supporting global data privacy and cybersecurity standards including LGPD, CPRA, GLBA, and NYDFS Reg 500. This person will engage with teams across regions and disciplines to help embed legal requirements into everyday practices through project support, training, and thoughtful documentation.

Key Responsibilities Include

  • Support business and IT projects by reviewing proposed data use, identifying privacy and cybersecurity requirements, assisting with Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), and helping resolve identified risks.
  • Partner with Legal, IT, and Compliance to ensure regulatory requirements are considered early in project planning—helping prevent costly rework, missed deadlines, and scope changes.
  • Support vendor oversight by maintaining an inventory of required privacy and security terms in standard contracts, tracking approved deviations, and identifying which vendors process personal data (PII). Coordinate with Legal to flag gaps and support ongoing vendor risk management.
  • Triage and respond to incoming questions about data privacy and security; maintain clear documentation of actions and decisions.
  • Monitor and assess digital tracking practices (e.g., website cookies) for compliance with global requirements.
  • Support privacy governance tools (e.g., BigID, OneTrust) by helping ensure legal requirements are reflected in data inventories, records of processing, and risk documentation.
  • Support responses to Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs) and related compliance reporting.
  • Help develop and deliver internal training to promote awareness and understanding of data privacy and legal requirements related to cybersecurity.
  • Follow all legal and compliance policies and report any potential issues or breaches.

What We’re Looking For

  • A Bachelor’s degree from an accredited 4-year institution.
  • 1–3 years of relevant experience, ideally in privacy, data governance, or security roles.
  • Working knowledge of regulations such as LGPD, CPRA, and NYDFS Reg 500.
  • Familiarity with tools like OneTrust or BigID is a plus.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate between legal, business, and technical teams.
  • Organized and detail-oriented; able to manage deadlines and work with cross-functional teams.
  • CIPP certification is a plus.
  • Fluency in English is required; fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is strongly preferred.

Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about protecting data, collaborating across global teams, and growing your career in a purpose-driven environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of our inclusive team.

Hy Cite is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity, recognizing that it builds stronger teams. Being an equal opportunity employer means that we take our responsibility seriously to consider qualified applicants on the basis of merit, without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expressions, age, mental or physical disability, genetic information, marital status, citizenship, military status, protected veteran status or any other category protected by applicable law.

Com mais de dez anos de história, o PicPay é um ecossistema completo de serviços financeiros e não-financeiros que tem como objetivo atender as necessidades diárias de milhares de pessoas e negócios, tornando-se a sua principal conta do dia a dia.

O respeito, a ética, a busca pela equidade e a valorização da pluralidade são elementos inegociáveis e fazem parte da prática no nosso dia a dia aqui no PicPay. Por isso, esta vaga está aberta para todas as pessoas, independente de gênero, religião, etnia, deficiência, idade, orientação sexual ou qualquer outro fator.

Sobre a vaga:

A área de Estratégia de Negócios da BU de Empréstimos do PicPay faz uma análise completa dos usuários e de seus dados bancários compartilhados para oferecer soluções de crédito adequadas. O desafio dessa posição é usar o conhecimento e vivência de produtos e negócios (produtos parcelados é um "plus") para ajudar o crescimento do negócio, oferecendo aos nossos usuários a melhor a oferta de crédito.

É muito importante ser capaz de compreender as implicações de uma proposta de novos produtos/negócios, sendo eficiente e preciso na análise. Fará o acompanhamento do P&L do produto, garantindo que nossas soluções otimizem receita, custos e despesas para a empresa. No dia a dia irá também acompanhar, coordenar e garantir o andamento dos projetos da área e inter-áreas com pouca supervisão.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Manipulação base de dados (principalmente SQL);

Experiência com produtos digitais financeiros;

Perfil analítico, com excelente capacidade de interpretar dados e observar tendências;

Além desse espírito de inovação, é essencial que você tenha boa capacidade de lidar com diferentes áreas e inclusive tocar o dia a dia com parceiros quando necessário;

Atuação em projetos que demonstre habilidade de organização, planejamento, comunicação clara/objetiva e estruturada.

  • Wellhub.

Antes de sabermos mais sobre suas características profissionais, convidamos você a conhecer um pouco da história da Santa Casa da

Bahia, instituição filantrópica que se propõe ao objetivo de ajudar aos mais necessitados.

Foi no ano de 1549, quando Tomé de Sousa ocupava o posto de governador-geral do Brasil, que foi construída uma casa de taipa e palha, no Centro Histórico de Salvador, que por cerca de 200 anos abrigou o Hospital de Caridade, primeiro hospital do Estado da Bahia, sendo o único a prestar assistência aos baianos na época.

Somente em 30 de julho de 1893 foi construído o Hospital Santa Izabel (HSI), no bairro de Nazaré, em Salvador, desativando a antiga

unidade de saúde que funcionava no Pelourinho. O prédio do primeiro hospital passou a ser a sede administrativa da Santa Casa da Bahia e, em 2006, se tornou o Museu da Misericórdia.

A Santa Casa da Bahia é uma associação beneficente de assistência social, que se propõe ao exercício da caridade e prestação de

serviços nas áreas de saúde, ensino, pesquisa, cultura, assistência social e educação, sem subordinação ao Estado ou à Igreja.

description:
AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals and minerals – safely, efficiently and more sustainably.

We’re the first software business in the world to have our sustainability targets validated by the SBTi, and we’ve been recognized for the transparency and ambition of our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We’ve also recently been named as one of the world’s most innovative companies.

If you’re a curious and collaborative person who wants to make a big impact through technology, then we want to hear from you! Find out more at AVEVA Careers.

Location: Mexico City or S ã o Paulo
Employment type: Full-time regular – Hybrid
IMPORTANT: Please apply for the job with an English version of your resume.

This role sits within the central IT Business Analysis team with a primary focus on digital delivery changes.

As a Business Analyst , you will be an inquisitive and strategic thinker who seeks to not only understand the root cause of a business or end user problem/opportunity, but to understand the drivers, asking the right questions at the right time. You will act as a critical friend, collaborating with and enabling stakeholders to make informed decisions based on sound analysis. You will translate the business's needs to provide the best value outcome for AVEVA, ensuring alignment to strategic and tactical aims.

You will work within the Business Analysis Service Framework to deliver a range of services that support the business in IT enabled change. You will also be encouraged to help support the continual progression of the Business Analysis Service, acting as a champion for it, fostering new relationships to build and grow its use and suggesting new ways of working to ensure it remains aligned to the needs of the business.

Responsibilities - You will do:

  1. Undertake analysis to understand how a business area works, considering the people, organization, processes, information, data, and technology.
  2. Identify and elaborate user and business needs to enable effective design, development, and business change.
  3. Ensure new solutions and services meet business and user needs, and are aligned with organizational goals.
  4. Understand any business and policy constraints that need to be considered, and assess the implications.
  5. Identify areas for improvement, explore feasible options, analyze the effects of change, and define success measures.
  6. Take ownership for improving your own knowledge of business analysis, methods, and tools and play an active role within the BA practice and wider community in sharing knowledge and supporting other members.

Skills & Qualifications - You will have:

  1. Business analysis : You can apply structured approaches to identify, investigate, analyze, and communicate complex business problems and opportunities, within a defined project.
  2. Requirements definition and management : You can identify, analyze, challenge, and validate business and user requirements.
  3. Stakeholder relationship management : You can identify, analyze, manage, and monitor relationships with and between internal and external stakeholders.
  4. Business modelling : You can model various elements of the business with limited direction. You can understand the effect of potential changes and how business processes, systems, structures, data, and roles and responsibilities interact with one another.
  5. Business process improvement : You can work with limited direction to identify opportunities to improve business performance within a defined project.
  6. Experience of collaborative working : You can work effectively and collaboratively alongside colleagues in a multidisciplinary team.

Preferred Qualifications - A PLUS:

  1. Experience of working within a large multinational organization/project team.
  2. Experience of working alongside system integrators such as Accenture, Cognizant, and specialist vendors in a delivery environment.
  3. Experience in working with software development tools such as Azure DevOps to gather and manage requirements.
  4. Experience in working with AVEVA’s key applications and the business processes they support. For sales related processes, this covers CRM (Salesforce), ERP (Oracle), and subscription management (Zuora).
  5. BCS Diploma in Business Analysis.
  6. IIBA Certified Business Analysis Practitioner.
  7. An educational degree in a related area to business analysis or equivalent related experience.

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, and credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third-party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.

O papel de Controlador Financeiro atua como um parceiro estratégico fundamental para o Diretor Geral, fornecendo insights financeiros estratégicos para apoiar a tomada de decisões e impulsionar o desempenho do negócio. Essa função é responsável por supervisionar todas as atividades contábeis, garantindo a precisão e integridade dos relatórios financeiros. Além disso, lidera os processos de orçamento, previsões e reportes, assegurando o cumprimento das metas financeiras, além de garantir conformidade regulatória e supervisionar os Controles Internos sobre Relatórios Financeiros (CIRF). O Controlador Financeiro também lidera atividades de TI relacionadas à melhoria dos sistemas financeiros e à gestão de dados, promovendo eficiência operacional.

PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES

Contabilidade e Relatórios Financeiros

  • Supervisionar as funções contábeis, garantindo a precisão das conciliações do balanço patrimonial e conduzindo o fechamento contábil mensal.
  • Assegurar a elaboração de relatórios precisos e dentro do prazo, conforme normas IFRS.
  • Gerenciar as equipes de Contabilidade, Contas a Pagar e Contas a Receber.
  • Supervisionar auditorias e controles internos para garantir conformidade e mitigar riscos financeiros.

Planejamento e Análise Financeira (FP&A)

  • Liderar o planejamento financeiro, orçamento e previsões, alinhando com os objetivos corporativos.
  • Analisar tendências de desempenho financeiro, identificando riscos e oportunidades estratégicas.
  • Preparar relatórios detalhados, dashboards e análises de variações para monitorar metas financeiras.

Parceria com as Operações

  • Colaborar com lideranças operacionais para iniciativas de redução de custos e eficiência.
  • Apoiar projetos de CAPEX com análises financeiras e acompanhamento de ROI.
  • Trabalhar com equipes de cadeia de suprimentos e compras para identificar oportunidades de economia.

Custeio e Gestão de Fluxo de Caixa

  • Suportar modelos de custeio e análises de precificação.
  • Revisar modelos de fluxo de caixa de novos pedidos para garantir fluxo positivo.

REQUISITOS DO CARGO

  • Habilidades de liderança, comunicação e influência.
  • Proficiência em modelagem financeira, previsão e análise de cenários.
  • Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas prioridades em ambientes dinâmicos.
  • Conhecimento avançado em ERP (SAP), Excel e normas IFRS.

FORMAÇÃO E EXPERIÊNCIA

  • Graduação em Finanças, Contabilidade, Administração ou áreas relacionadas.
  • CPA, CMA ou MBA preferencial, com registro no CRC.
  • Inglês avançado.
  • Ao menos 8 anos de experiência em funções financeiras, com 3 anos em cargos de liderança.

Diversidade & Inclusão na Prosegur

Cada um de nós enxerga o mundo de formas diferentes. Mas uma coisa deve ser comum a todos: o respeito. Acreditamos que a diversidade de perspectivas e experiências garantem um ambiente diferenciado de trabalho!

Acreditamos que times diversos podem garantir resultados espetaculares além de impulsionar nossa cultura inovadora.

Conheça esta oportunidade de trabalho na Segurpro/ Cash e se você possui os requisitos para a vaga, FAÇA JÁ A SUA INSCRIÇÃO.

* Vaga aberta a pessoas com ou sem deficiência. Se você é PCD e possui os requisitos e interesse, junte-se à nossa equipe de Heróis de Sangue Amarelo e venha ser Protagonista de uma história de sucesso!
